decision: Required to start the Sprint and the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The suspension setup has been changed while under Parc Fermé.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint and the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The setup was modified whilst the car was in parc fermé with the approval of the Technical Delegate further to a written request. The suspension setup has been changed from that previously used in Qualifying. The competitor is therefore required to start the Sprint and the Race from the pit lane per article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
